envelope_assumptions.nuisance_state: dynamic intercept/drift grid or wind coefficient corners and individual drifts
envelope_assumptions.weighting: fixed isotropic design noise; no fitted gyro coefficients or residual weights
envelope_assumptions.limitations: Finite development grid, not a bound over every admissible nuisance trajectory

physical_envelope_assumptions.nuisance_state: bounded north/east wind corners and drifts crossed with TAS levels/drifts
physical_envelope_assumptions.weighting: fixed gyro noise 3 and 6 dph and conditional GNSS speed constraint; no gyro fit/residual weights
physical_envelope_assumptions.limitations: Finite development grid, not a bound over every admissible nuisance trajectory

wind_tas_policy.evidence: Conditional GNSS speed constraint with latent smooth TAS; no independent heading or airspeed observation
wind_tas_policy.provenance: Provisional development assumptions; independent wind truth, calibration and hardware checks required

evidence_scope: finite assumed-geometry envelope; no simulator, fit, power or acceptance certification
